name: Mini Circuit Racers
summary:
Strap into the cockpit and race three rivals round eight circuits: five on tarmac (Lakeside Park, Forest Speedway, Desert Sprint, Neon Strip and Hillside Ring) and three dirt tracks with jumps (Mudlark Rallycross, Ridgeback Hills and Eightwood Crossover).

DRIFT ON THE BRAKE: hold the brake as you turn and the car swings round the bend, keeping its speed. Let go to straighten up. Barriers slide you along instead of stopping you dead.
